seed: Objects of type `reflection` under action ACTION1 with touching neighbours [counter] show mixed outcomes: pixels,w,x x2, h,pixels,w,x,y x1. Find the condition in the before state that decides the outcome. Start from this kind of condition: the exact click position relative to the object, when the action is a click. Verify it against every transition before you keep it.

synth.notes:
Prior-session 147-line stateless rule reused unchanged (session 3038c7d9). 21x21 board of 3x3 blocks: axis band ring 10, targets 11, pieces ring 5 (sel centre 0), reflections ring/centre 4 at row 2A-r.
A1/A2 move selected axis or piece one block row; A3/A4 move a selected piece one column (axis selected -> no-op); pieces blocked by board edge and other pieces only.
A5 cycles axis -> pieces by size desc -> axis; HUD col 63 turns one 11->12 per effective action.
Hypothesis refuted: A1 is not a click, so click position cannot decide it; the reflection pixels/w/x vs h/pixels/w/x/y mix is re-extraction of reflections as the axis moves (they merge/split/clip at the board edge).
Unconfirmed: whether pieces may enter the axis row (not exercised by these data).
